item.title: Lawmaker Kim Seung-won on Lee's "Haven't Read the Criminal Procedure Act" Remark: "He Knows Full Well What's in It" (與 김승원, 李 ‘형소법 안읽어봐서’ 발언에 “내용 다 알고계실 것”)
item.description:
Lawmaker Kim Seung-won on Lee's "Haven't Read the Criminal Procedure Act" Remark: "He Knows Full Well What's in It" (與 김승원, 李 ‘형소법 안읽어봐서’ 발언에 “내용 다 알고계실 것”)

Regarding the Criminal Procedure Act, which includes the abolition of prosecutors' supplementary investigative powers and was pushed through by the Democratic Party of Korea, Democratic Party lawmaker Kim Seung-won said on the 7th, "(President Lee Jae-myung) probably knows full well what the new Criminal Procedure Act contains." <<> This is a response to President Lee Jae-myung's question at a recent Cabinet meeting, "I haven't read the amended Criminal Procedure Act, but does it say under the amended act that prosecutors must not investigate?" <<> On this day, Lawmaker Kim appeared on YTN Radio and, when asked, "Isn't it because the bill processed by the Democratic Party didn't quite sit well with the president?", said, "We held informal meetings with numerous people. We also consulted with the Prime Minister's Office, the Ministry of Justice, and the Ministry of the Interior and Safety, so it wasn't a unilateral bill." <<> Regarding Justice Minister Jung Sung-ho and others saying, "There should be exceptional supplementary investigative powers," Kim said, "It's fine for prosecutors to conduct supplementary investigations directly, but as I mentioned earlier, after granting those powers, there are actually dozens of cases like 'Go change the typo and bring it back' and other such directives." <<> Regarding the investigation of powerful figures, including politicians—particularly the probe into lawmaker Kim Byung-ki, who left the Democratic Party, which has been delayed for nearly a year—Kim said, "I've heard that the investigation will soon be wrapped up and the results announced." <<> He added, "We established the Senior Officials Corruption Investigation Office, a kind of Korean FBI, where veteran police officers, prosecutors, and prosecution investigators work together to keep each other in check," and "Shouldn't rewards for the public or promotions be handled much better than they are now?" (더불어민주당 주도로 강행 처리한 검찰의 보완수사권 폐지 내용을 담은 형사소송법에 대해 민주당 김승원 의원이 “(이재명 대통령은) 새로운 형사소송법 내용이 어떤 건지 아마 다 알고 계실 것”이라고 7일 말했다.)

item.title: People Power Party Ethics Committee begins disciplinary proceedings against lawmakers Seo Beom-su and Jin Jong-oh over 'spin-kick remark' (국힘 윤리위, ‘돌려차기 발언’ 서범수·진종오 징계 절차 개시)
item.description:
People Power Party Ethics Committee begins disciplinary proceedings against lawmakers Seo Beom-su and Jin Jong-oh over 'spin-kick remark' (국힘 윤리위, ‘돌려차기 발언’ 서범수·진종오 징계 절차 개시)

The People Power Party's Ethics Committee on the 7th launched disciplinary proceedings against pro-Han Dong-hoon lawmakers Seo Beom-su and Jin Jong-oh, who exchanged inappropriate jokes during an emergency meeting attended by the victim of the "Busan spin-kick case." This came just one day after the party leadership effectively requested disciplinary action against the two lawmakers at a supreme council meeting the previous day. (국민의힘 윤리위원회가 7일 ‘부산 돌려차기 사건’ 피해자가 참석한 긴급 간담회에서 부적절한 농담을 주고받은 친한계 서범수·진종오 의원에 대한 징계 절차를 개시했다. 전날 국민의힘 지도부가 최고위에서 두 의원에 대한 사실상 징계를 요청한 지 하루 만이다.)

The People Power Party's Ethics Committee announced this in a press release on the afternoon of the same day. The two lawmakers had previously come under fire for inappropriate jokes during a meeting on the 4th regarding the prohibition of supplementary investigations by prosecutors, hosted by independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon, who had invited the victim of the Busan spin-kick case, Kim Jin-joo (pseudonym). Before Kim arrived, Rep. Seo said to Rep. Jin, "How about a spin-kick?" to which Jin, a former national shooting team member, replied, "I'm better with my hands than my feet." <<> However, Rep. Seo issued a statement shortly afterward apologizing to Kim, and Kim accepted the apology, asking the party to focus its efforts on abolishing the supplementary investigation authority. Rep. Jin also stated that he personally visited Kim in Busan that day to apologize. Floor leader Chung Jin-suk is also known to hold the position that preventing recurrence should take priority over disciplining the two lawmakers. Chung issued a public apology the previous day over the two lawmakers' remarks. <<> While beginning disciplinary proceedings against the two lawmakers, the People Power Party's Ethics Committee also decided to send questionnaires for fact-finding investigations regarding lawmakers Cho Kyung-tae, Kwon Young-jin, and Jin Jong-oh, whose disciplinary procedures were initiated on the 27th of last month. <<> Rep. Cho was referred to the Ethics Committee for allegedly appealing to lawmakers of other parties to work against the election of People Power Party Vice National Assembly Speaker Park Duk-hyum. Rep. Kwon was subject to disciplinary action for grabbing the collar of Floor Leader Chung Jin-suk while protesting the allocation of National Assembly standing committee positions. Pro-Han lawmaker Jin's support for then-independent candidate Han Dong-hoon during the Busan Buk-gu by-election is cited as the reason for disciplinary action. <<> Meanwhile, at the Ethics Committee meeting that day, two of the seven committee members, who had previously raised issues with Ethics Committee Chairman Yoon Min-woo's unilateral management of the committee, attended and expressed their intention to resign. <<> Vice Chairman Woo Jong-hwan and Committee Member Hwang Kyung-sung issued a statement that day, saying, "We intend to resign with heavy hearts, taking responsibility for the internal turmoil within the Ethics Committee." They attended the meeting and demanded the chairman's concurrent resignation, but Chairman Yoon reportedly gave no particular response. <<> In their statement, they said, "We requested a joint resignation to mend the dysfunction of the Ethics Committee and restore trust, but Chairman Yoon effectively refused," and added, "We earnestly urge Chairman Yoon, who is at the center of various allegations, to make a honorable choice on his own before leaving an indelible stain and even greater suspicions in history." Earlier, they had demanded the chairman's resignation after raising suspicions that he had leaked disciplinary information to outside individuals. (국민의힘 윤리위는 이날 오후 보도자료를 내고 이같이 밝혔다. 앞서 두 의원은 지난 4일 무소속 한동훈 의원이 부산 돌려차기 사건의 피해자 김진주(가명)씨를 초청한 가운데 연 검찰 보완수사 금지와 관련한 간담회에서 부적절한 농담으로 구설에 올랐다. 김씨가 도착하기 전 서 의원은 진 의원에게 “돌려차기 한번 하죠?”라고 말했고, 사격 국가대표 출신인 진 의원은 “저는 발보다 손을 잘 쓴다”고 했다.)

item.title: Board of Audit and Inspection Expresses "More than Regret, a Grave Sense of Responsibility" Over Unprecedented Indictment of Incumbent Audit Commissioner (초유의 현직 감사위원 구속 기소에 감사원 “송구함 넘어 엄중한 책임감 느껴”)
item.description:
Board of Audit and Inspection Expresses "More than Regret, a Grave Sense of Responsibility" Over Unprecedented Indictment of Incumbent Audit Commissioner (초유의 현직 감사위원 구속 기소에 감사원 “송구함 넘어 엄중한 책임감 느껴”)

As the second special counsel team indicted and detained Audit Commissioner Yoo Byung-ho on charges of abusing his authority in connection with the audit of former President Yoon Suk Yeol's presidential residence relocation on the 7th, the Board of Audit and Inspection (BAI) stated, "We feel more than regret—a grave sense of responsibility—for causing public concern over the operational independence of the BAI and the fairness, objectivity, and neutrality of audits." (2차 종합특검이 7일 유병호 감사원 감사위원을 윤석열 전 대통령 관저 이전 감사와 관련해 직권을 남용한 혐의로 구속 기소하자 감사원이 “감사원의 직무상 독립성과 감사의 공정성·객관성·중립성에 관해 국민 여러분께 심려를 끼쳐드려, 송구함을 넘어 엄중한 책임감을 느낀다”고 했다.)

The BAI released a statement that afternoon saying this and adding, "We will observe the upcoming trial proceedings with a solemn and humble attitude." (감사원은 이날 오후 입장문을 배포해 이같이 밝히고 “앞으로 진행될 재판 과정을 엄중하고 겸허한 자세로 지켜보겠다”고 했다.)

It continued, "Using this incident as an opportunity for deep reflection, we will devote every effort to being reborn as an institution that unwaveringly carries out the duties entrusted to it by the Constitution and laws." (이어 “이번 사태를 계기로 거듭 성찰해, 헌법과 법률이 부여한 본연의 임무를 흔들림 없이 수행하는 기관으로 거듭나도록 모든 노력을 다하겠다”고 했다.)

The special counsel believes that Commissioner Yoo, while serving as Secretary General of the BAI during the Yoon Suk Yeol administration, suppressed certain findings from the audit of the presidential office and residence relocation at the request of the presidential office. It is alleged that he prevented the audit team from demanding document submissions from the presidential office and instructed that contractors involved in the presidential office and residence relocation project be subject to written inquiries rather than in-person interviews. (특검은 유 위원이 윤석열 정부 시절 감사원 사무총장으로 재직하면서, 감사원이 대통령실·관저 이전 감사에서 적발한 사항 일부를 대통령실 청탁을 받고 무마했다고 보고 있다. 감사팀이 대통령실을 상대로 자료 제출을 요구하지 못하게 하고, 대통령실·관저 이전 공사 업체 관련자를 상대로 대면 조사가 아닌 서면 조사를 하게 했다는 것이다.)

Commissioner Yoo denies the charges. When appearing before the special counsel last month, he stated, "During an audit concerning construction contracts for the presidential office and residence used by the head of state or the first lady, not an ordinary public official, the decision to choose written inquiry methods, taking into comprehensive consideration the characteristics of 'Class A' (highest-level) security facilities, strong resistance to the audit from the presidential office and others, the speed and reliability of the audit, due process, and the protection of human rights, is being made the subject of an investigation—this constitutes a deviation of public authority from its original purpose." (유 위원은 혐의를 부인하고 있다. 유 위원은 지난달 특검에 출석하면서 “일반 공직자도 아니고 국가원수 또는 영부인이 사용하는 대통령 집무실과 관저 관련 공사 계약 등에 관한 감사가 진행되는 중, ‘가’급(최고 등급) 보안 시설의 특성, 대통령실 등 일부의 강력한 감사 저항, 감사의 신속성과 신뢰성 및 적법 절차와 인권 보장 등을 종합적으로 고려해 서면 조사 방법을 선택한 행위를 수사 대상으로 삼는 것은 공권력이 본래의 목적에서 이탈하고 있는 것”이라고 했다.)

This marks the first time an incumbent audit commissioner has been indicted. Under the status protection provisions of the Board of Audit and Inspection Act, Commissioner Yoo retains his position as audit commissioner despite the indictment and detention. However, his authority to exercise his duties is suspended until a final ruling, and if he is sentenced to imprisonment or a heavier penalty, he will be automatically removed from office even without a final conviction. (현직 감사위원이 기소된 것은 처음이다. 감사원법의 신분 보장 조항에 따라 유 위원은 구속 기소에도 감사위원직을 유지한다. 다만 확정 판결 전까지 권한 행사가 정지되고, 금고 이상 형을 선고받았을 때에는 확정 판결이 아니더라도 당연 퇴직된다.)

Conversely, if he is acquitted at all levels from the first trial through the final appeal before his term expires in February 2028, he could return to his position as audit commissioner. Commissioner Yoo is known not to have expressed an intention to resign from his post. (반면 2028년 2월까지인 임기 만료 전까지 1심에서 최종심까지 모두 무죄 판결을 받는 경우에는 감사위원으로 복귀할 수 있다. 유 위원은 감사위원직 사직 의사를 밝히지는 않은 것으로 알려졌다.)

item.title: Government subsidy fraud reaches record 129.6 billion won last year (정부 보조금 부정 수급, 지난해 역대 최대 1296억원 적발)
item.description:
Government subsidy fraud reaches record 129.6 billion won last year (정부 보조금 부정 수급, 지난해 역대 최대 1296억원 적발)

The amount of subsidies fraudulently claimed and received by some citizens and businesses from the central government, local governments, and public institutions reached a record 129.6 billion won last year, the largest ever. (일부 국민과 기업이 정부나 지방자치단체, 공공기관에 보조금을 부정 청구해 타냈다가 적발된 금액이 지난해 역대 최대인 1296억원에 달한 것으로 나타났다.)

According to results announced on the 7th by the Anti-Corruption and Civil Rights Commission (ACRC), which inspected the "implementation status of the public finance recovery system" targeting government and public institutions that provide "public financial payments" such as subsidies to the private sector, 311 institutions detected 141,781 cases of fraudulent receipt last year and decided to recover 129.6 billion won. Additional penalty surcharges imposed on fraudulent recipients amounted to 50 billion won. (국민권익위원회가 민간에 보조금 등 ‘공공 재정 지급금’을 주는 정부·공공기관을 대상으로 ‘공공 재정 환수 제도 이행 실태’를 점검해 7일 발표한 결과에 따르면, 311개 기관이 지난해 부정 수급 14만1781건을 적발해 1296억원을 환수하기로 결정했다. 부정 수급자에게 벌칙으로 추가로 받아내는 ‘제재 부가금’은 500억원이었다.)

The amount of detected fraudulent receipt rose 24% from 104.2 billion won in 2024, and penalty surcharges rose 74% from 28.8 billion won in 2024, both reaching record highs. The ACRC attributed the increase in detected fraudulent receipt amounts to the growth in the scale of public financial payments provided to the private sector by government and public institutions, an increase in reports of fraudulent receipt, and strengthened inspection activities against fraudulent receipt. (부정 수급 적발 금액은 2024년 1042억원보다 24%, 제재 부가금은 2024년 288억원보다 74% 늘었고, 모두 역대 최대 규모다. 부정 수급 적발 금액이 늘어난 데 대해 권익위는 정부·공공기관이 민간에 주는 공공 재정 지급금의 규모가 늘었고, 부정 수급 신고도 늘었으며, 부정 수급 점검 활동을 강화했기 때문이라고 평가했다.)

By type of fraud, fraudulent receipt of livelihood benefits provided to basic livelihood security recipients was the most common, with 28,886 cases amounting to 29 billion won. Fraudulent receipt of COVID-19-related loss compensation support funds for small business owners ranked second, with 6,360 cases totaling 22 billion won. (부정 수급 유형별로 보면, 기초 생활 수급자에게 제공되는 생계 급여를 부정 수급한 경우가 2만8886건, 290억원으로 가장 많았다. 코로나19와 관련해 지급된 소상공인 손실 보상 지원금을 부정 수급한 경우가 6360건, 220억원으로 그다음으로 많았다.)

Fraudulent receipt of housing benefits provided to basic livelihood security recipients amounted to 27,115 cases and 10.3 billion won, while fraudulent receipt of support from programs providing social insurance premiums such as employment insurance and industrial accident insurance totaled 38,340 cases and 7 billion won. Ten cases of fraudulent receipt of support funds related to regional investment promotion projects were also detected, with the scale of fraudulent receipt averaging 620 million won per case, totaling 6.2 billion won. (기초 생활 수급자에게 제공되는 주거 급여를 부정 수급한 경우는 2만7115건, 103억원이었고, 고용보험·산재보험 등 사회보험료를 지원하는 사업에서 부정하게 지원을 받은 경우가 3만8340건, 70억원이었다. 지역 투자 촉진 사업과 관련한 지원금 부정 수급도 10건 적발됐는데 부정 수급 규모가 1건당 평균 6억2000만원씩 총 62억원에 달했다.)

Fraudulent receipt of eco-friendly vehicle subsidies involved 1,226 cases and 3.3 billion won, fraudulent receipt of youth job creation support funds involved 363 cases and 3.2 billion won, fraudulent receipt of research and development funds involved 109 cases and 2.6 billion won, and fraudulent receipt of support funds for the "clean workplace creation support" project involved 154 cases and 2.4 billion won. (친환경 자동차 보조금 부정 수급은 1226건 33억원, 청년 일자리 창출 지원금 부정 수급은 363건 32억원, 연구·개발비 부정 수급은 109건 26억원, ‘클린 사업장 조성 지원’ 사업 지원금 부정 수급은 154건, 24억원이었다.)

In addition, cases of receiving agricultural direct payments by falsely claiming to have cultivated fields that were not cultivated were detected in 4,451 cases amounting to 1.8 billion won, and cases of receiving single-parent family support while concealing marriage or de facto marital relationships were detected in 1,851 cases totaling 1 billion won. There were 685 cases, amounting to 300 million won, involving receipt of fuel subsidies while closed for business or using fuel subsidies for vehicles not eligible for support. There were also 2,116 cases, totaling 300 million won, of fraudulent receipt of scholarships, including receiving national work-study scholarships by pretending to have worked without actually doing so. (이 밖에도 논밭을 경작하지 않으면서 경작한 것처럼 속여 농업 직불금을 받은 경우가 4451건, 18억원 적발됐고, 혼인이나 사실혼 관계를 숨기고 한부모 가족 지원금을 받은 경우가 1851건, 10억원 적발됐다. 폐업 상태에서 유가 보조금을 받았거나 유가 보조금을 지원 대상이 아닌 차량의 주유에 썼다가 걸린 경우가 685건, 3억원 있었다. 일하지 않고 일한 것처럼 꾸며서 국가 근로 장학금을 받는 등 장학금을 부정 수급한 경우도 2116건, 3억원 있었다.)

ACRC Vice Chairperson Lee Myung-soon stated, "Fraudulent receipt of public financial payments is an act that seriously undermines fairness in our society. We will substantially strengthen the system to eradicate it and secure transparency in public finances through active enforcement demands and the promotion of reporting." (권익위 이명순 부위원장은 “공공 재정 지급금의 부정 수급은 우리 사회의 공정성을 심각하게 훼손하는 행위로, 이를 뿌리 뽑을 수 있도록 제도를 실질적으로 강화하고, 적극적인 처분 요구와 신고 활성화를 통해 공공 재정의 투명성을 확보하겠다”고 밝혔다.)

item.title: Prime Minister Says "Gaps" in Childcare Programs..."Must Be Fixed One by One" (韓총리 “아동 돌봄 사업에 빈구석… 하나씩 고쳐야”)
item.description:
Prime Minister Says "Gaps" in Childcare Programs..."Must Be Fixed One by One" (韓총리 “아동 돌봄 사업에 빈구석… 하나씩 고쳐야”)

Prime Minister Han Sung-sook said on the 7th that the government's programs for caring for children in place of their parents have several "gaps," and urged improvements. (한성숙 국무총리가 7일 정부가 아동을 부모 대신 돌봐주는 사업에 여러 “빈구석”이 있다고 지적하고 개선을 당부했다.)

That morning, the Prime Minister visited Yeongmun Elementary School in Yeongdeungpo-gu, Seoul, where a "vacation childcare" program was running to care for students during the elementary school break, and held a meeting with school officials and parents to hear their opinions. Officials from the Ministry of Education and the Seoul Metropolitan Office of Education also attended the meeting. (한 총리는 이날 오전 초등학교가 방학 중에 학생들을 돌봐주는 ‘방학 중 돌봄’ 사업이 진행되고 있는 서울 영등포구 영문초를 찾아 학교 관계자 및 학부모들과 간담회를 하고 의견을 들었다. 간담회에는 교육부와 서울시교육청 관계자들도 동석했다.)

The Prime Minister said, "There is the 'elementary childcare' program run by schools, and there are childcare programs run by various institutions, and policies for childcare for small business owner families, but gaps are gradually appearing." He pointed out, "In some places (childcare hours) start at 10 o'clock, in others at 9 o'clock, so it works in some places and doesn't in others." He also added, "It seems there are inconvenient and difficult aspects about where and how to apply." (한 총리는 “학교에서 하는 ‘초등 돌봄’ 사업이 있고, 여러 기관이 하는 돌봄 사업, 소상공인 가족 돌봄 관련 정책이 있는데, 빈구석이 조금씩 보인다”고 했다. 한 총리는 “(돌봐주는 시간이) 어디는 10시부터이고, 어디는 9시부터이고, 그래서 어디는 되고, 어디는 또 안 되고 하는 부분들이 있는 것이 보인다”고 지적했다. “어디에 어떻게 신청해야 하는지도 불편하고 어려운 점이 있는 것 같다”고도 했다.)

He continued, "Some parts seem like they can be improved a bit," and "If we keep fixing them one by one, things will gradually get better." (이어 “어떤 부분은 좀 더 개선할 수 있을 것 같다”며 “하나씩 고쳐가다 보면 점점 좋아질 것”이라고 했다.)

The Prime Minister nevertheless assessed that the current childcare programs are producing positive effects. He said, "Recently, a (presidential) work report was released, and thanks to the teachers who worked hard on the ground and the various childcare programs, private education costs for elementary school students in third grade and below decreased considerably, reducing the overall burden of private education." (한 총리는 다만 현재의 돌봄 사업도 긍정적인 효과를 내고 있다고 평가했다. 그는 “얼마 전에 (대통령) 업무 보고 자료가 나왔는데, 현장에서 애써 주신 선생님들과 각종 돌봄 사업 덕분에 초등학교 3학년 이하의 사교육비가 꽤 많이 줄어서, 전체적으로 사교육 부담이 줄었다”고 했다.)

On the 5th, the Ministry of Education said in its presidential work report that the total amount of private education spending and participation rate this year decreased by 1.7 trillion won and 4.3 percentage points, respectively, compared to last year, citing the childcare programs as the main factor. Minister Choi Kyo-jin said, "This year, we have actively supported the areas of private education that preschool and elementary school students in grades 1-3 received according to childcare needs." President Lee Jae-myung asked, "So should I understand that as we expanded integrated childcare, sending kids to cram schools out of necessity has decreased?" and Minister Choi replied, "That's correct." (지난 5일 교육부는 대통령 업무 보고에서 올해 사교육비 총액과 참여율이 지난해보다 각각 1조7000억원, 4.3%포인트 줄었다며, 주된 요인은 돌봄 사업이라고 했다. 최교진 장관은 “올해 들어 유아나 초등학교 1~3학년 학생이 돌봄 필요에 따라 받은 사교육 분야를 우리가 적극 지원하게 됐다”고 했다. 이재명 대통령은 “통합 돌봄을 확대하면서 억지로 학원 보내는 게 줄었다고 이해하면 되느냐”고 물었고 최 장관은 “그렇다”고 답했다.)

The Prime Minister's Office said that at the meeting, the Prime Minister emphasized that "the childcare support system must be developed more densely so that childcare blind spots do not occur," and urged the Ministry of Education and the education offices to "ensure that the various entities supporting childcare both inside and outside schools closely cooperate and collaborate, so that children and parents do not miss out on the childcare benefits they can enjoy." (총리실은 간담회에서 한 총리가 “돌봄 사각지대가 발생하지 않도록 돌봄 지원 체계를 촘촘하게 발전시켜 나가야 한다”며 교육부와 교육청에 “학교 안팎에서 다양한 돌봄을 지원하는 주체들이 긴밀하게 연계·협업해, 아이들과 학부모들이 누릴 수 있는 돌봄 혜택을 받지 못하는 일이 없도록 하라”고 당부했다고 밝혔다.)

The Prime Minister's Office reported that the Prime Minister stressed, "Childcare must continue without interruption, not only during the school term but also during vacations," and "It is the government's important responsibility to build a childcare support system that allows parents to leave their children at any time and enables children to grow up safely." (한 총리는 “학기 중은 물론 방학 중에도 돌봄이 중단 없이 이어져야 한다”며 “부모들은 언제라도 아이를 맡길 수 있게 하고, 아이들은 안전하게 성장할 수 있는 돌봄 지원 체계를 만드는 것이 정부의 중요한 책무”라고 강조했다고 총리실은 전했다.)

item.title: Lee: "Apology to Victims of State Violence... No Statute of Limitations on State Responsibility" (李 “국가폭력 피해자에 사과... 국가 책임에 유효기간 없어”)
item.description:
Lee: "Apology to Victims of State Violence... No Statute of Limitations on State Responsibility" (李 “국가폭력 피해자에 사과... 국가 책임에 유효기간 없어”)

<<>> President Lee Jae-myung said on the 7th to victims of state violence and their bereaved families, "I offer my deepest condolences and apologies to all victims of state violence that have occurred on this land since liberation." He added, "As president, I will carry a heavy sense of responsibility and strive to ensure that not a single innocent victim emerges." ()

At a luncheon meeting held at the presidential office (Cheong Wa Dae) to invite victims of state violence in connection with the launch of the third term of the Truth and Reconciliation Commission, President Lee said, "The state must now take responsibility and heal the wounds it has inflicted on its citizens." About 70 victims and bereaved family members of past atrocities attended the luncheon, including those affected by the Sabuk incident, forced conscription and reeducation/guidance operations, the case of fishermen abducted to North Korea and later returned, and human rights abuses at the Brothers' Home and collective detention facilities. (이재명 대통령은 7일 국가폭력 피해자와 유가족들에게 “해방 이후 이 땅에서 벌어진 모든 국가폭력 사건 피해자들께 깊은 위로와 사과의 말씀을 드린다”고 밝혔다. 그러면서 “단 한 사람의 무고한 희생자도 나오지 않도록 대통령으로서 무거운 책임의식을 가지고 노력하겠다”고 했다.)

In his opening remarks before the luncheon, President Lee acknowledged state responsibility for state violence and offered a formal apology to victims and their families. He said, "I feel a deep sense of responsibility for the state's failure to adequately respond to the earnest questions of the victims," and conveyed his deep condolences and apologies to all victims of state violence that have occurred since liberation. (이 대통령은 이날 청와대에서 열린 진실·화해를위한과거사정리위원회 3기 출범과 관련한 국가폭력 피해자 초청 오찬 간담회에서 “국가가 국민에게 남긴 상처를 이제는 국가가 책임지고 치유해 나가야 한다”며 이같이 말했다. 오찬에는 사북 사건, 강제징집 녹화·선도공작, 납북귀환어부 사건, 형제복지원 및 집단 수용시설 인권유린 등 과거사 피해자 및 유가족 70여 명이 참석했다.)

Regarding the launch of the third term of the Truth and Reconciliation Commission, President Lee said, "We will add three more investigation bureaus to the commission to thoroughly uncover the truth about human rights abuses at collective detention facilities, including the Brothers' Home and Deokseongwon, which were not fully revealed in previous investigations, as well as cases of forced overseas adoptions." (이 대통령은 오찬에 앞서 모두 발언에서 국가폭력에 대한 책임을 인정하고 피해자 및 유가족에게 공식 사과했다. 그는 “그동안 국가가 피해자들의 간절한 물음에 충분히 응답하지 못했던 점에 대해 깊은 책임감을 느낀다”며 해방 이후 발생한 모든 국가폭력 사건 피해자들에게 깊은 위로와 사과의 뜻을 전했다.)

He particularly emphasized, "There is no statute of limitations on state responsibility," and added, "We have established the principle that claims for damages caused by state violence shall not be subject to statutes of limitations, ensuring the state cannot evade responsibility for its wrongdoing." <<>> (이 대통령은 진실·화해를위한과거사정리위원회 3기 출범과 관련해 “위원회에 조사3국을 추가로 설치해 기존 조사 과정에서 미처 다 밝혀내지 못했던 형제복지원, 덕성원을 포함한 집단 수용 시설의 인권 유린과 해외 강제 입양 사건도 철저하게 그 진실을 규명해 나가게 될 것”이라고 했다.)

item.title: [Exclusive] Doctor-turned lawmaker Cha Ji-ho of the ruling party to run for WHO Director-General ([단독] ‘의사 출신’ 與차지호, WHO 사무총장 도전)
item.description:
[Exclusive] Doctor-turned lawmaker Cha Ji-ho of the ruling party to run for WHO Director-General ([단독] ‘의사 출신’ 與차지호, WHO 사무총장 도전)

Cha Ji-ho, a lawmaker from the Democratic Party of Korea with a medical background, has decided to run in the election for the next Director-General of the World Health Organization (WHO). (의사 출신인 더불어민주당 차지호 의원이 차기 세계보건기구(WHO) 사무총장 선거에 출마하기로 했다.)

According to political circles, Rep. Cha is currently preparing the nomination process to challenge for the WHO Director-General post. It has been reported that he is also collecting signatures of recommendation from fellow Democratic Party lawmakers. The deadline for submitting nominations for candidates for the next WHO Director-General election is the 24th of next month. (정치권에 따르면, 차 의원은 최근 WHO 사무총장 선거에 도전하기 위한 후보 추천 절차를 준비 중이다. 이를 위해 민주당 의원들에게 추천서 연명도 받는 것으로 전해졌다. WHO 차기 사무총장 선거 후보자 추천 마감일은 내달 24일이다.)

Rep. Cha, a former physician, has experience working with numerous international organizations, including Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF). He also has extensive overseas experience, having earned a master's degree in refugee studies from Oxford University and a doctorate in international health from Johns Hopkins University. Since entering the National Assembly in the 22nd general election, he has also collaborated with various international bodies such as the WHO and the International Labour Organization (ILO). (차 의원은 의사 출신으로 국경없는의사회(MSF) 등 다수의 국제기구에서 활동한 경력을 가지고 있다. 옥스퍼드대에서 난민학 석사를, 존스홉킨스대에서 국제보건학 박사를 취득하는 등 해외 경험도 풍부하다. 22대 총선에서 국회에 입성한 이후에도 WHO, ILO(국제노동기구) 등 다양한 국제기구와 협력했다.)

The next WHO Director-General will be appointed at the World Health Assembly (WHA) scheduled to take place in Geneva, Switzerland, in May next year, with a five-year term beginning in August next year. If Rep. Cha is elected as WHO Director-General, he would become the second Korean to hold the post, following the late Lee Jong-wook, who was elected as the sixth Director-General in 2003. (차기 WHO 사무총장은 내년 5월 스위스 제네바에서 열리는 세계보건총회(WHA)에서 임명되며, 임기는 내년 8월부터 5년이다. 차 의원이 WHO 사무총장에 선출될 경우, 2003년 6대 사무총장으로 선출됐던 이종욱 전 총장 이후 두 번째 한국인 총장이 된다.)

A representative from Rep. Cha's side said, "If he is ultimately elected as WHO Director-General, it would likely be difficult to maintain his parliamentary seat." The WHO Director-General's primary duty station is Geneva, Switzerland. (차 의원 측은 “WHO 사무총장으로 최종 선출될 경우 의원직을 유지하기는 쉽지 않을 것 같다”고 했다. WHO 사무총장의 주된 근무지는 스위스 제네바다.)

item.title: [Exclusive] 'Record-High' Subsidy Fraud Recovery: Even If It Means Installment Payments, the Money Will Be Reclaimed ([단독] ‘역대 최대’ 보조금 부정 수급, 분할 납부하게 해서라도 받아낸다)
item.description:
[Exclusive] 'Record-High' Subsidy Fraud Recovery: Even If It Means Installment Payments, the Money Will Be Reclaimed ([단독] ‘역대 최대’ 보조금 부정 수급, 분할 납부하게 해서라도 받아낸다)

The government has decided to require public institutions that fail to promptly recover subsidies from fraudulent recipients and do not impose penalty surcharges to explain their reasons, as part of efforts to curb the recent surge in subsidy fraud. The identity of whistleblowers who report subsidy fraud by others will be protected, and if legal fees arise in connection with such reports, the government will cover those attorney fees as well. To increase recovery rates, fraudulent recipients will also be allowed to pay back recovered amounts in installments. (정부가 최근 급증하는 보조금 부정 수급을 줄이기 위해, 부정 수급자에게서 보조금을 제때 환수하지 않고 제재 부가금도 물리지 않는 공공기관은 그 사유를 소명하게 하기로 했다. 다른 사람의 보조금 부정 수급을 신고한 사람의 신분은 보호하고, 관련해 변호사비가 발생한 경우에는 변호사비까지 대주기로 했다. 부정 수급자에게는 환수금 분할 납부를 허용해 환수율을 높이기로 했다.)

The Anti-Corruption and Civil Rights Commission (ACRC) announced on the 7th that it has pre-legislated amendments to the enforcement decree of the Public Finance Recovery Act containing these measures. The amendments will take effect after review by the Ministry of Government Legislation, deliberation by the vice-ministerial meeting and the Cabinet meeting, and presidential approval. It has been reported that there are no disagreements among relevant ministries regarding these amendments, so they are expected to be implemented as announced by the ACRC. (국민권익위원회는 최근 이 같은 내용을 담은 공공재정환수법 시행령 개정안을 입법 예고했다고 7일 밝혔다. 개정안은 법제처 심사와 차관회의·국무회의 심의, 대통령 재가를 거쳐 시행된다. 이 개정안에 관해서는 관계 부처 간 이견이 없어, 권익위가 예고한 안대로 시행될 것으로 알려졌다.)

Under the current Public Finance Recovery Act, individuals who fraudulently obtain "public financial payments" such as subsidies from the government or public institutions must repay the full amount of the subsidy received plus interest. As a penalty for the fraudulent act, they are also required to pay an additional "penalty surcharge" of up to five times the amount of the subsidy received. If they fail to pay within the deadline set by the government or public institution, it is treated the same as delinquent taxes. (현행 공공재정환수법은 정부·공공기관이 주는 보조금 등 ‘공공 재정 지급금’을 부정하게 타낸 사람에 대해, 애초에 받은 보조금 전액에 이자까지 붙여서 토해내도록 하고 있다. 부정행위에 대한 벌칙으로, 받은 보조금의 최대 5배에 달하는 ‘제재 부가금’도 추가로 내야 한다. 정부·공공기관이 정한 기한 내에 이를 내지 않으면, 세금을 체납한 것과 똑같이 취급한다.)

In such cases, the responsibility for collecting the principal, interest, and penalty surcharge from fraudulent recipients lies with the institution that originally provided the subsidy. However, there were institutions that, despite identifying subsidy fraudsters through joint investigations with the ACRC, failed to take timely recovery measures against those fraudulent recipients. (이때 부정 수급자에게서 보조금 원금과 이자, 제재 부가금을 받아내는 일은 애초에 부정 수급자에게 보조금을 준 기관이 해야 한다. 그러나 권익위와의 합동 조사 등으로 보조금 부정 수급자를 찾아냈는데도, 해당 부정 수급자에 대한 보조금 환수 조치를 제때 하지 않는 기관이 있었다.)

In response, the ACRC has decided to require government agencies and public institutions to fully explain to the ACRC the reasons for not carrying out subsidy recovery and penalty surcharge collection duties. (이에 대해 권익위는 정부·공공기관이 보조금 환수와 제재 부가금 징수 업무를 하지 않은 경우, 그 사유를 권익위에 반드시 소명하도록 했다.)

Additionally, when subsidy fraud by companies or organizations is revealed through a report, it has been decided to prohibit such companies or organizations from disadvantaged treatment of the whistleblower. This includes prohibitions on dismissal, removal from office, other disciplinary actions, or discriminatory reductions in wages or bonuses. If the whistleblower is an outsider to the company or organization, actions such as canceling relevant licenses or permits or terminating contracts to disadvantage the whistleblower are also prohibited. Companies or organizations that violate these rules will face enforcement fines of up to 30 million won. (또 기업·단체 등의 보조금 부정 수급이 신고로 드러난 경우, 해당 기업·단체가 신고자에게 불이익을 주는 것을 금지하기로 했다. 파면·해임하거나, 다른 징계를 주거나, 임금이나 상여금을 차별적으로 적게 주는 것이 금지된다. 신고자가 기업·단체의 외부인인 경우, 관련 인·허가를 취소하거나 계약을 해지하는 등의 방식으로 불이익을 주는 것도 금지된다. 이를 지키지 않는 기업·단체에는 최대 3000만원의 이행 강제금을 부과하기로 했다.)

If a whistleblower appoints an attorney as their representative to file an anonymous report of fraud, or appoints an attorney to respond to audits, investigations, criminal probes, or lawsuits arising from the report, the attorney fees will be covered by the government. (신고자가 부정 수급을 익명으로 신고하기 위해 변호사를 대리인으로 선임한 경우, 신고로 인해 감사나 조사, 수사, 소송 등을 당해 이에 대응하기 위해 변호사를 선임한 경우에는 변호사비를 대주기로 했다.)

Fraudulent recipients who must pay subsidy recovery amounts and penalty surcharges will be allowed to pay in installments. They will be permitted to divide the amount owed into up to three payments at intervals of up to two months. The goal is to enhance the effectiveness of collecting subsidy recovery amounts and penalty surcharges, thereby recovering the maximum possible amount from fraudulent recipients. (보조금 환수금과 제재 부가금을 내야 하는 부정 수급자에게는 분할 납부를 허용하기로 했다. 내야 하는 금액을 최대 2개월 간격으로, 최대 3회에 걸쳐 나눠 낼 수 있게 했다. 보조금 환수금과 제재 부가금 징수의 실효성을 높여, 부정 수급자로부터 최대한의 금액을 돌려받자는 것이다.)

The reason the ACRC has moved to strengthen the system for recovering fraudulently obtained subsidies is that as government and public institution subsidy payments have increased, subsidy fraud has also surged. According to the ACRC, public financial payments from the government and public institutions to the private sector grew from 241 trillion won in 2021 to 317 trillion won last year, an increase of 31.5% over four years, and subsidy fraud cases detected last year reached 141,781 cases amounting to 129.6 billion won. (권익위가 부정 수급 보조금 환수 관련 제도를 강화하게 된 것은, 정부·공공기관의 보조금 지급이 늘어나면서 보조금 부정 수급도 급증하는 것으로 나타났기 때문이다. 권익위에 따르면 정부·공공기관이 민간에 주는 공공 재정 지급금은 2021년 241조원에서 지난해 317조원으로 4년 만에 31.5% 늘었고, 지난해 적발한 보조금 부정 수급은 14만1781건, 1296억원에 달했다.)

item.title: President Lee appoints Kim Tae-yoo as Vice Chairman of Regulatory Rationalization Committee, succeeding Lee Byung-tae (李대통령, 이병태 후임 규제합리화위 부위원장에 김태유 인선)
item.description:
President Lee appoints Kim Tae-yoo as Vice Chairman of Regulatory Rationalization Committee, succeeding Lee Byung-tae (李대통령, 이병태 후임 규제합리화위 부위원장에 김태유 인선)

President Lee Jae-myung on the 7th appointed Kim Tae-yoo, a professor at Seoul National University's College of Engineering, as Vice Chairman of the Regulatory Rationalization Committee, and named Kim Heung-kyu, a professor of Political Science and International Relations at Ajou University and director of the U.S.-China Policy Research Institute, as President of the Korea National Diplomatic Academy. Kang Yu-jung, spokesperson for the presidential office, announced this in a written briefing. (이재명 대통령은 7일 규제합리화위원회 부위원장에 김태유 서울대 공대 교수를 위촉하고, 국립외교원장에 김흥규 아주대 정치외교학과 교수 겸 미중정책연구소장을 임명했다. 강유정 청와대 대변인은 서면 브리핑을 통해 이같이 밝혔다.)

The new Vice Chairman of the Regulatory Rationalization Committee, Kim Tae-yoo, previously served as the presidential secretary for information, science, and technology during the Roh Moo-hyun administration. Regarding the background of the appointment, the presidential office stated, "He is the right person to design macro-level regulatory rationalization strategies linked to advanced industries such as AI, semiconductors, and robotics, based on a deep understanding of industry and technology in an era of technological hegemony," adding, "With convergent insight and leadership spanning the public and private sectors, he will lead regulatory innovation to elevate the Republic of Korea into a 'technology-centered ultra-gap First Mover.'" <<> The newly appointed President of the Korea National Diplomatic Academy, Kim Heung-kyu, is a leading scholar in East Asian diplomatic security and U.S.-China relations, and a practical diplomacy expert with extensive experience in academic research, policy advisory, and fieldwork. Having served as a professor at the Institute of Foreign Affairs and National Security, the predecessor of the Korea National Diplomatic Academy, he is also highly regarded for his deep understanding of the institution. The presidential office stated, "He will elevate the Korea National Diplomatic Academy into a top-tier research and educational institution for the AI era, and further strengthen the establishment of a strategic research foundation that firmly supports national interest-centered practical diplomacy, as well as the cultivation of future diplomatic talent." (김태유 신임 규제합리화위원회 부위원장은 노무현 정부 시절 대통령 정보과학기술보좌관을 지냈다. 청와대는 인선 배경에 대해 “기술 패권 시대에 산업과 기술에 대한 깊은 이해를 바탕으로 AI, 반도체, 로봇 등 첨단 산업과 연계된 거시 규제합리화 전략을 설계할 적임자”라며 “민관을 아우르는 융합적 통찰과 리더십으로 대한민국을 ‘기술 중심의 초격차 퍼스트 무버(First Mover)’로 도약시킬 규제 혁신을 이끌 것”이라고 했다.)

item.title: President Lee declares Andong and Uiseong in North Gyeongsang Province as special disaster zones (李대통령, 경북 안동·의성 특별재난지역으로 선포)
item.description:
President Lee declares Andong and Uiseong in North Gyeongsang Province as special disaster zones (李대통령, 경북 안동·의성 특별재난지역으로 선포)

At around 5 p.m. on the 7th, President Lee Jae-myung declared four myeons under the jurisdiction of Andong City and Uiseong County in North Gyeongsang Province, which suffered extensive damage from heavy rains that lasted from July 8 to 24, as special disaster zones. (이재명 대통령은 7일 17시께, 지난 7월 8일부터 24일까지 이어진 호우로 큰 피해가 발생한 경상북도 안동시와 의성군 관할 4개 면을 특별재난지역으로 선포했다.)

Areas declared as special disaster zones will receive additional national funding for disaster recovery, and affected residents will also receive additional support such as deferred payment of national and local taxes and reductions in public utility fees. (특별재난지역으로 선포된 지역은 재난 복구를 위한 국비가 추가로 지원되고, 피해 주민에 대해서도 국세·지방세 납부 유예, 공공요금 감면 등이 추가로 지원된다.)

Kang Yu-jeong, the senior presidential spokesperson for the Blue House, stated, "The government plans to finalize the recovery plan as soon as possible and make active efforts to ensure that residents in the affected areas can quickly return to their daily lives." (강유정 청와대 수석대변인은 “정부는 빠른 시일 내 복구 계획을 확정해, 피해 지역 주민이 조속히 일상으로 복귀할 수 있도록 적극 노력할 계획”이라고 했다.)

item.title: Lawmaker Hwang Hee of opposition party: "Let's remodel discarded buses into youth housing" (與 황희 “폐기된 버스 리모델링해 청년주택 제공하자”)
item.description:
Lawmaker Hwang Hee of opposition party: "Let's remodel discarded buses into youth housing" (與 황희 “폐기된 버스 리모델링해 청년주택 제공하자”)

Three-term lawmaker Hwang Hee of the Democratic Party of Korea proposed on the 7th, "Let's remodel discarded buses into residential spaces and provide them as short-term housing for young people near college campuses." (더불어민주당 3선 황희 의원이 “폐기되는 버스를 주거 공간으로 리모델링하고, 대학가 청년들의 단기성 주거 공간으로 제공하자”고 7일 제안했다.)

Hwang, a member of the National Assembly's Land, Infrastructure and Transport Committee, wrote on his Facebook page that day, "I have seen boat houses lined up along the canals of Amsterdam, the Netherlands," and suggested that the concept could be applied in South Korea as "bus houses." (국회 국토교통위 소속의 황 의원은 이날 자신의 페이스북에 “네덜란드 암스테르담 운하에 보트 하우스(boat house)가 즐비하게 있는 것을 본적이 있다”며 우리나라에도 버스 하우스(bus house)로 적용해볼 수 있다고 제안했다.)

He said, "Even if the remodeling cost is estimated at around 50 million won per unit, for 10,000 households, the total would be only about 500 billion won," adding, "Depending on the conversion method, we could also design mobile bus houses that can move under their own power, or trailer-type bus houses that can be transported by external vehicles." (그는 “리모델링 비용을 5000만원 정도만 잡아도, 1만 세대면 전체 5000억 수준에 불과”하다며 “개조 방식에 따라, 자체 운전을 통해 이동가능한 이동형 버스 하우스, 외부 차량을 통해 이동이 가능한 트레일러형 버스 하우스를 설계해 볼 수도 있다”고 했다.)

He also said, "Since the government's housing supply policies are highly dependent on the private sector, the pace could be slow," and added, "This could serve as temporary housing for young people until they secure stable homes, and it has the advantage of being quickly deployable, so it is certainly worth examining." (또 “정부의 주택공급 정책이 민간 의존도가 매우 높은 관계로, 그 속도가 더딜 수 있다”며 “청년들이 안정된 주택을 마련하기 전 단계까지 임시 주거 공간으로 활용할 수 있고, 아울러 신속하게 공급할 수 있는 장점이 있어 충분히 검토할 가치는 있다”고 했다.)

Earlier, the Democratic Party had urged the People Power Party to "cooperate in passing the housing supply bills promoted by the government and the Democratic Party." Floor leader Park Hong-keun also criticized, "The very ones blocking the follow-up legislation to the government's supply measures are none other than the People Power Party." Policy committee chairperson Han Jeong-ae also said, "The housing supply cliff in Seoul is also a result produced by Mayor Oh Se-hoon." (앞서 민주당은 국민의힘을 향해 “정부와 민주당이 추진하는 주택 공급 법안 처리에 협조하라”고 했다. 한병도 원내대표도 “정작 정부의 공급 대책 후속 법안을 가로막고 있는 장본인이 다름 아닌 국민의힘”이라고 비판한 바 있다. 한정애 정책위의장도 “서울의 주택 공급 절벽 현상은 오세훈 시장이 만들어낸 결과물이기도 하다”고 했다.)

item.title: Lee Holds Six-Hour Real Estate Meeting... "Housing Supply, Break Free from Existing Mindsets and Act Boldly" (李, 6시간동안 부동산 회의... “주택공급, 기존 사고방식 벗어나 과감히 실천”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung received reports on expanding real estate supply and swift implementation measures at a policy review meeting on the 7th aimed at stabilizing the real estate market. (이재명 대통령이 7일 부동산 시장 안정화를 위한 정책 점검 회의에서 부동산 공급 확대와 신속한 실행 방안을 보고 받았다.)

The President presided over the second real estate policy review meeting from 2 p.m. to 8 p.m. that day, lasting approximately six hours. This came just four days after his directive at the first meeting on the 3rd to "prepare measures to maximize supply volume and advance the supply timeline as much as possible." (이 대통령은 이날 오후 2시부터 8시까지 약 6시간 동안 부동산 정책 점검 2차 회의를 주재했다. 앞서 지난 3일 1차 회의에서 “공급 물량을 최대한 늘리고 공급 시기를 최대한 앞당기기 위한 방안을 마련하라”고 지시한 지 나흘 만이다.)

At the meeting, the President received reports from relevant ministers and committee chairs on the direction and plans for financial support to promote housing supply, as well as measures to induce and support the early supply of real estate, according to Senior Secretary for Public Relations Kang Yu-jung of the presidential office in a written briefing. (이날 회의에서 이 대통령은 관계부처 장관들과 위원장으로부터 주택공급 촉진을 위한 금융 지원 방향 및 방안과 함께 부동산의 조기 공급 유도 및 지원 방안을 보고 받았다고 강유정 청와대 수석대변인은 서면 브리핑을 통해 전했다.)

Senior Secretary Kang stated, "During the six-hour meeting, broad proposals for full-scale supply expansion and rapid implementation measures were extensively presented and carefully reviewed." However, she did not disclose specific plans or timelines. (강 수석대변인은 “6시간에 걸친 회의 과정 동안 전폭적인 공급 확대와 이에 대한 신속 실행 방안이 폭넓게 개진되었으며, 면밀한 검토가 이뤄졌다”고 밝혔다. 다만 구체적인 방안와 시기에 대해선 밝히지 않았다.)

Concluding the meeting, the President urged Prime Minister Han Sung-sook and relevant ministers, saying, "Do not cling to existing mindsets—make transformative judgments, think boldly, and act decisively." (이 대통령은 회의를 마무리하며 한성숙 국무총리와 관계부처 장관들을 향해 “기존 사고 방식에 매달리지 말고 전환적으로 판단해서 과감히 생각하고 실천하라”고 당부했다.)

item.title: People Power Party Attacks Hwang Hui over 'Bus House': "Why Don't You Try Living in One Yourself" (국힘, ‘버스하우스’ 황희에 “본인부터 살아보라” 맹폭)
item.description:
The People Power Party on the 7th fiercely criticized Hwang Hui, a lawmaker from the Democratic Party of Korea, for proposing to remodel retired buses into short-term housing for young people, calling it "the remark of the century" and demanding "he should go live in one himself." The Democratic Party drew a line, saying it was "a personal opinion unrelated to the party's stance." (국민의힘은 7일 폐버스를 리모델링해 청년 단기 주거 공간으로 제안한 황희 더불어민주당 의원을 향해 “희대의 망언” “본인부터 들어가 살라”고 맹비난했다. 민주당은 “당 입장과 관련 없는 개인 의견”이라며 선을 그었다.)

People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk said in a Facebook post that day about Hwang's proposed 'Bus House': "How about the President, ministers, senior presidential secretaries, and the children of Democratic Party lawmakers move in first as a pilot case?" Jang added, "Instead of creating jobs for young people, he's telling them to live in a 'converted bus'—this is mocking young people who are already struggling." (장동혁 국민의힘 대표는 이날 페이스북 글에서 황 의원이 제안한 ‘버스하우스’를 두고 “대통령, 장관, 청와대 수석, 민주당 의원님 자녀들부터 시범 케이스로 들어가 살아보면 어떠겠느냐”고 했다. 장 대표는 “청년들에게 일자리를 만들어 주기는커녕 ‘개조 버스’에 들어가 살라는 것”이라면서 “안 그래도 힘든 청년들을 우롱하는 것”이라고 했다.)

Fellow party lawmaker Kim Eun-hye also criticized it as "the remark of the century." She said, "The President labeled the public as speculators while slyly selling his own home, the policy chief cut all the jeonse budget for young people while covering his own child's jeonse deposit, and now on top of all that, they're telling young people to live in a bus? If it's so great, the Democratic Party should live in one for generations." (같은 당 김은혜 의원도 “희대의 망언”이라고 비판했다. 김 의원은 “국민을 투기꾼으로 낙인찍고 자신은 꼼수로 집을 판 대통령, 청년 전세 예산 다 깎아놓고 자신은 자녀에게 전세금 대준 정책실장, 이걸로 모자라 이제는 청년들에게 버스에 살라는 것이냐”면서 “그렇게 좋으면 민주당부터 대대손손 사시라”고 했다.)

Senior spokesperson Park Chung-kwon said, "Failing to build a proper housing supply chain and then coming out with something like this is a clear insult to the younger generation," and demanded, "Withdraw the remarks immediately and apologize." Lawmaker Joo Jin-woo likewise said, "The very fact that they came up with this idea shows the Democratic Party's housing policy has completely failed," adding, "They should be prostrating themselves in apology to the public and sacking those responsible, yet instead they're spouting nonsense like this." (박충권 수석대변인은 “제대로 된 주거 공급망 하나 구축하지 못해 놓고 이제 와서 이런 말을 하는 것은 청년 세대에 대한 명백한 모욕”이라면서 “발언을 즉각 철회하고 사과하라”고 했다. 주진우 의원 역시 “이런 발상을 한다는 것 자체가 민주당의 부동산 정책이 폭망했다는 뜻”이라면서 “국민에게 석고대죄하고, 책임자들을 경질해도 모자랄 판에 이 무슨 망발이냐”고 했다.)

Hwang had posted on Facebook that afternoon a message proposing to "remodel discarded buses into residential spaces and provide them as short-term housing for young people near university districts." After criticism, especially from younger people saying "Hwang should try living in one first," he deleted the post. He then posted a follow-up explanation saying it was "purely at the level of an idea," but as the controversy continued, he deleted that too. He subsequently posted again, proposing a "mixed-use development of housing and education facilities" as a housing supply measure. (황 의원은 이날 오후 페이스북에 “폐기되는 버스를 주거 공간으로 리모델링해 대학가 청년들의 단기 주거 공간으로 제공하자”는 취지의 글을 올렸다가, 청년층을 중심으로 “황 의원부터 살아보라”는 비판이 이어지자 삭제했다. 황 의원은 “순수한 아이디어 차원이었다”는 해명 글을 올렸지만 논란이 계속되자 이 역시 삭제했다. 이후 “주택공급책으로 ‘주교복합개발’을 제안한다”는 글을 재차 올렸다.)

Democratic Party senior spokesperson Kang Jun-hyun drew a line, calling it "a lawmaker's personal opinion completely unrelated to the party's stance." (민주당 강준현 수석대변인은 “당 입장과는 전혀 관련이 없는 의원의 개인적 의견”이라고 선을 그었다.)
